'''2014 US Nationals Day 2 Matt Carulli DS Invasion''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Matt Carulli]] at [[2014 US Nationals]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Invasion|Theed-D-invasion.gif}}
* '''Username:''' quickdraw345
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
